subject.title: build(deps): bump the swift-deps group across 1 directory with 3 updates

question: Should the macOS owners accept the grouped SwiftLog, Sparkle, and swift-concurrency-extras upgrades after a current-head native validation resolves the failing `macos-swift` check?
rationale: The lockfile-only patch is mechanically narrow, but Sparkle is user-facing update infrastructure and the available check evidence does not establish whether the current native failure is unrelated or a dependency-compatibility regression.

options.title: Validate and merge
options.body: Refresh against current `main`, obtain a successful native macOS resolve/build or update-path proof, and merge if the failed check is resolved or shown unrelated.

options.title: Pause the grouped bump
options.body: Leave the existing pins in place until a macOS owner can validate the new dependency graph and Sparkle behavior.

recommendation.title: Validate and merge
recommendation.body: Refresh against current `main`, obtain a successful native macOS resolve/build or update-path proof, and merge if the failed check is resolved or shown unrelated.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR timeline explicitly routed this macOS dependency discussion to steipete; no stronger file-history owner could be established from the available read-only evidence.
